description: Address proof missing or expired: utility bill or rent lease for the residence is absent or out of date.
action: Request a fresh address proof (utility bill not older than three months, or rental agreement).

description: Identity document mismatch: name or spelling on the passport or licence differs from the application, or the photo is unclear.
action: Verify identity in person or by video call and correct the master record.

description: Source of funds unclear: income and large deposits are unexplained or unsupported by salary or business papers.
action: Collect income evidence and a source-of-funds declaration.

description: High risk review: politically exposed person, cash intensive business or overseas remittances need enhanced due diligence.
action: Escalate to enhanced due diligence with compliance sign-off.

description: Periodic refresh: dormant or inactive account whose review is due after many years.
action: Schedule the periodic KYC refresh and contact the customer.
